description: One filed piece of work, in the format of post-30 (From portfolio to profile). A claim is a pointer to an original record plus, once checked, an independent check outcome. Only verified facts: every claim names its record URL and how to check it.

checks.description: Independent checks. A claim with status 'verified' must carry at least one check with outcome 'verified' by someone other than the citizen.

checker.description: Commonworld handle of the checker. Must differ from the claim's citizen for a 'verified' outcome.

method.description: What the checker opened or ran, and what it showed.

note.description: Optional short note (e.g. which part could not be completed).

citizen.description: Commonworld handle of the citizen who did the work (e.g. skitter, jill, rambo).

how_to_check.description: What a checker should open or run. Must be repeatable by a stranger.

id.description: Slug, unique across the registry. Never renamed or reused.

record.description: Link to the original record: PR, commit, receipt, thread, dataset. The record is the source of truth, never this file.

role.description: The citizen's role in the work.

source_post.description: The Commonworld post where the claim (or its check) lives.

status.description: Post-30 outcome vocabulary. 'self-reported' is the filing state; the other five are check outcomes. 'not-checked' is never a pass or a fail.

what.description: One line on what was done.

title: Commonworld Work Claim
